scope: Define a deterministic compositional writing layer above authoritative G01-G40 without changing phoneme identity, lexicon, grammar, morphology, curriculum authority or visual canon.

source_facts.strict_cv_family_matches: 26/33 audited forms; statistical authoring preference only

rules.proposal: A Mix-Glifo encodes one explicitly resolved phonological grouping, never a guessed grouping.
A single root phoneme may occupy a Mix-Glifo cell by itself.
Adjacent vowel phonemes remain separate nuclei by default; no automatic VV/VVV fusion into one Mix-Glifo.
G30 /ts/ is one atomic root and must never be split into T+S.
G40 /y/ must never be silently reinterpreted as G16 /j/.
CV, VC, CVC, clusters and other multi-root groupings require explicit syllabification/grouping authority before being compressed into one Mix-Glifo.

Canonical Mix-Glifo geometry is role-based, not arbitrary: NUCLEUS occupies the central anchor; PRE_NUCLEAR material occupies ordered satellite anchors; POST_NUCLEAR material occupies ordered terminal anchors.
Root identity must remain recoverable from the composite; destructive deformation is forbidden.
Rotation and mirroring are forbidden in V1 unless a future visual-canon gate proves they preserve identity.
Overlap may not erase a diagnostic stroke or make two distinct root sequences visually identical.
V1 maximum compressed payload is four authoritative root G-IDs; longer groupings remain sequential until separately governed.
Because current root drawings are PREPRODUCTION_NOT_OFFICIAL_VISUAL_CANON, V1 geometry is a layout contract only; it does not promote Candidate D.

candidate_anchor_model.NUCLEUS: centered primary anchor; largest visual share
candidate_anchor_model.note: Anchor coordinates/sizes remain implementation parameters until visual review; semantic meaning is not assigned to direction.

rules.proposal: Composite identity is derived from ordered root G-IDs plus an explicit grouping profile; transliteration is never the primary key.
Same ordered G-ID sequence + same grouping profile must produce the same Mix-Glifo layout.
Different ordered sequences must not share one composite key.
A decoder must recover the exact ordered G-ID sequence and grouping metadata losslessly.
PUA allocation for Mix-Glifos is deferred; composite keys are transport-safe identifiers until a separate encoding/font gate.

NUCLEUS_SEQUENCE.reason: B3 preserves adjacent vowels as distinct nuclei by default; no productive fusion inventory.

CV.reason: CV is common but not a mandatory syllable grammar; explicit grouping authority still required.

VC.reason: Attestation of VC word shape does not itself establish syllable-compression authority.

CVC.reason: Final consonants are legal, but exact syllabification/grouping remains unresolved.

CLUSTERED.reason: Internal clusters are case-by-case and cannot become a generic compression template from attestation alone.

illustrative_not_licensed.note: Demonstrates deterministic syntax only; does not assert that this sequence is an approved HNK syllable.
DAYI-related sequence must not be collapsed by inference; approved careful nuclei A|Y|I and unresolved syllabification are preserved.

human_gate_decisions.decision: Approve Mix-Glifo as a compositional writing layer above G01-G40, not a replacement for root G-IDs.
Approve ROOT profile immediately; all multi-root compression remains gated by explicit grouping/syllabification authority.
Approve the role-based geometry contract NUCLEUS/PRE/POST while keeping exact coordinates and current Candidate D visuals noncanonical.
Forbid rotation/mirroring and destructive deformation in V1.
Approve maximum four root G-IDs per compressed V1 cell.
Approve lossless deterministic MX1 keying and defer PUA/font allocation.

non_rules: No new syllable boundaries are inferred from spelling.
No semantic value is assigned to glyph position, direction, size or overlap.
No diphthong or glide rule is created.
No universal CV/CVC grammar is created.
No Candidate D drawing becomes official visual canon.
No lexeme, meaning, grammar rule, morphology rule or curriculum slot is promoted.
next_if_approved: Implement MX1 encoder/decoder + geometry validator using ROOT as executable profile and multi-root profiles as gated fixtures; then open a separate syllabification authority batch based on governed corpus evidence.
